title: Phenotype Clean Row
description: One row in phenotype_clean.csv. Output of Phase 4. 36 columns per biosample.

sample_id_local.description: Local sample identifier from ENA sample_name or paper

disease.description: Disease label (NSCLC, melanoma, ulcerative_colitis, healthy, etc.)

intervention_type.description: High-level intervention category (immunotherapy, fmt, diet, etc.)

intervention_group.description: Sample-level group assignment (FMT, placebo, FOS_Cohort_1, etc.)

intervention_source.description: Source file or API for intervention group

phenotype_source.description: Source of phenotype data (ncbi_biosample, supplement_xlsx, ena_xml, etc.)

timepoint_label.description: Granular phase label (baseline, run_in, feeding_1, feeding_2, washout, on_treatment, followup, etc.)

timepoint_index.description: Numeric timepoint index (day or sample sequence number)

is_intervention.description: Is this sample from an active intervention period?

paired_pre_sample.description: Preceding sample accession(s) for this subject, semicolon-delimited

paired_post_sample.description: Following sample accession(s) for this subject

total_samples.description: Total distinct timepoints for this subject

pairing_confidence.description: How confident is the longitudinal pairing?

parallel_samples.description: Other biosamples at same timepoint + same intervention group

context_role.description: Contextual role of this ID (donor, mum, baby, family)

notes.description: Free-text notes (protocol deviations, mapping issues, etc.)

subject_id_confidence.description: Confidence level of subject ID parsing
